description: Add a workspace, one per brand. Needs a connection set to "All workspaces" by an owner or admin. Check workspaces_list `plan.workspaces` first: when used has reached cap, this fails with PLAN_LIMIT. Times in it use its timezone (an IANA name such as Europe/London); ask for the brand's zone, since left out it copies the organization's first workspace.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

name: workspace_create
title: Create a workspace
